reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June and said I wouldn't act on it, as she asked.

I also suggested she post a correction in #north-team herself, since people there will still see the old date. I didn't open #north-team or repeat what she posted there. The renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to confirm in this channel.
